title: aphanamixis rohituka
intro: Aphanamixis rohituka, commonly known as Indian alkanet, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, cough, and digestive issues, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, treat infections, and act as an antioxidant, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various health conditions.
